senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. pl. Tyre in Phœnicia.
units: Gen. R. s. 61 end כל צ׳ … מלא בצ׳ מדינה וכ׳ wherever in Scripture Tsor is written plene, the city of Tyre is meant, where it is defective (צר enemy), Rome is meant; Tanḥ. Bo 4; Pesik. R. s. 17. Y. B. Kam. IV, 4ᵇ סולמייא דצ׳; Y. Ab. Zar. I, 40ᵃ bot., v. סוּלָּם, סוּלָּמָא; a. fr.—Denom. צוֹרִי, צוֹרִיִּי.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 8:7">Bekh. VIII, 7</cite>, a. e. <he>מנה צ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M01724"><he>מָנֶה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 821:1">Yalk. Deut. 821</cite> <he>סייף צוריי</he> a Tyrian sword (Tanḥ. Vaëtḥ. 6 <he>הנדיי</he>).

<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 3:5">Maasr. III, 5</cite>, v. <cite ref="H01544"><he>חָצֵר</he></cite>; a. fr.—Chald. <cite ref="R00248"><he>צוֹרָאָה</he></cite>; pl. <he>צוֹרָאֵי</he>, <cite ref="R00254"><he>צוֹרָיֵיא</he></cite>. Y. Sabb. II, 4ᶜ bot.; Y. Meg. II, 73ᵇ bot.
